badgeOverflow.items: Ordered badge data to fit inside the available width.
badgeOverflow.renderBadge: Renders an item in both the visible and measurement layers.
badgeOverflow.lineCount: Maximum number of badge rows before overflow is collapsed.
badgeOverflow.getBadgeLabel: Returns the label. Required for object items; primitives use String(item).
badgeOverflow.getBadgeKey: Returns a stable key. The computed label is used by default.
badgeOverflow.renderOverflow: Customizes the popover trigger. Defaults to a bordered +count badge.
badgeOverflow.render: Changes the root element using Base UI render composition.
badgeOverflow.className: Additional root classes. The computed CSS gap is included in fitting calculations.
